description_en: Runs a manual workflow. Submit and deploy the manual workflow in the target environment so that it appears in Operation Center before you call this operation
description_zh: 手动业务流程必须已在环境界面提交发布，之后运维中心才会显示对应手动业务流程，您才可以使用该接口，触发手动业务流程运行
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public run-manual-dag-nodes --project-env PROD --project-name test_workspace --flow-name test_workflow --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunManualDagNodes

parameters.help_en: The environment identifier in Operation Center. PROD indicates the production environment, and DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心的环境标识。PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The English name of the workspace to which the manual workflow belongs
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间英文名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the manual workflow
parameters.name: flow_name

parameters.help_en:
The business date. The value must be earlier than or equal to the current date minus one day. For example, if today is November 11, 2020, the business date must be 00:00:00 on November 10, 2020 or earlier. The hour, minute, and second values of the business date must all be set to 00. You can specify either this parameter or the combination of the StartBizDate and EndBizDate parameters.

Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. Example: `2020-11-11 00:00:00`
parameters.help_zh:
业务日期的值为小于等于当前日期-1天。例如，今天是2020年11月11日，则业务日期需要是2020年11月10日的00:00:00或者该日期之前的日期。业务日期的时分秒信息均填写00。
StartBizDate与EndBizDate参数配合使用，当前参数与StartBizDate和EndBizDate参数只能配置一个。

格式示例为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，例如 `2020-11-11 00:00:00`
parameters.name: biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The node parameters passed when the manual workflow is executed. These parameters correspond to the scheduling parameters configured in the properties of the nodes in the manual workflow.

The value is a JSON string in the following format: { "<Node ID in the manual workflow>": "Scheduling parameters of the node, which must be in the same format as the parameters in the scheduling configuration of Data Studio", "<Node ID in the manual workflow>": "Scheduling parameters of the node, which must be in the same format as the parameters in the scheduling configuration of Data Studio" }
parameters.help_zh:
传递手动业务流程执行时的节点参数信息，对应手动业务流程里的节点属性配置的调度参数。

一个JSON格式： { "<手动业务流程内部的某个节点ID>": "节点的调度参数信息，和数据开发调度配置里面的参数格式保持一致", "<手动业务流程内部的某个节点ID>": "节点的调度参数信息，和数据开发调度配置里面的参数格式保持一致" }
parameters.name: node_parameters

parameters.help_en: The parameters that are synchronized to all instances in the current DAG. If the scheduling parameters of an internal node (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147245.html) reference the business flow parameters in DagParameters, the corresponding parameter values of the node are replaced with the business flow parameters in DagParameters
parameters.help_zh: 该参数会同步至本次Dag的所有实例中。如果内部节点（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147245.html）的调度参数引用了DagParameters中的业务流程参数，则节点的对应参数值会被替换为DagParameter中的业务流程参数
parameters.name: dag_parameters

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the nodes to be run in the manual workflow. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 如果需要运行手动业务流程里的部分节点，可输入相应节点ID。多个节点ID使用逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: include_node_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the nodes that do not need to be run in the business flow. When the specified nodes are run, dry-run instances are generated. After a dry-run instance is scheduled, it directly succeeds without executing the script content. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).
The ExcludeNodeIds parameter takes effect only when it is used together with the IncludeNodeIds parameter
parameters.help_zh:
如果不需要运行业务流程里的部分节点，可输入相应节点ID。此处输入的节点运行时会生成空跑实例，空跑实例被调度后会直接运行成功，不会执行脚本内容。多个节点ID使用逗号（,）分隔。
ExcludeNodeIds参数需要与IncludeNodeIds参数同时使用，ExcludeNodeIds参数的配置才会生效
parameters.name: exclude_node_ids

parameters.help_en:
The start business date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
This parameter must be used together with the EndBizDate parameter. You can specify either this parameter combination or the BizDate parameter
parameters.help_zh:
获取业务开始日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。
StartBizDate与EndBizDate参数配合使用，并且当前参数与BizDate参数只能配置一个
parameters.name: start_biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The end business date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
This parameter must be used together with the StartBizDate parameter. You can specify either this parameter combination or the BizDate parameter
parameters.help_zh:
获取业务结束日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss。
StartBizDate与EndBizDate参数配合使用，并且当前参数与BizDate参数只能配置一个
parameters.name: end_biz_date

DagId.description_en: The instance ID of the DAG for the manual workflow. You can use the API operation and this DAG ID to query the details and status of the internal node instances for this execution of the manual workflow
DagId.description_zh: 手动业务流程运行Dag的实例ID。您可以通过接口和该DagId查询此次手动业务流程运行的内部节点实例的详细信息和状态

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
